objective: Build a multi-client TCP chat server and client. Every message a client sends is broadcast to all other connected clients, prefixed with the sender's name. A client can choose its name by sending '/nick NAME'; until then its name is clientN. The /nick line itself is not broadcast.
acceptance_criteria: two clients connected at the same time both get each other's messages
after '/nick alice' the other clients receive 'alice: hello' for 'hello'
a client that disconnects does not break the others
